title: Jocose
summary: JOCO'SE, adjective [Latin jocosus, from jocus, a joke.] 1. Given to jokes and jesting; merry; waggish; used of persons. 2. Containing a joke; sportive; merry; as jocose or comical airs.

inlines.v: JOCO'SE, adjective [Latin jocosus, from jocus, a joke.] 1. Given to jokes and jesting; merry; waggish; used of persons. 2. Containing a joke; sportive; merry; as jocose or comical airs.
